summary: Operator site + Firefly: confirmed 17 back-in full-hookup sites (50/30/20 amp), no showers/bathroom/laundry, $40 nightly (dated by a live 2027 one-night quote), year-round; added wifi, booking terms, Firefly URL as booking.url, military 10%, weekly/monthly figures. Note cleaned. Long-stay tests all pass (6 of 17 sites open on a June 2027 weeknight); the Nov/Dec 2026 searches were stopped by a reCAPTCHA.
flags: Long-stay tests (weekly $255 / monthly $525 + electric marketed; 'overnight, weekly, and extended stays'; operator-quoted reviews 'I stayed 13 weeks for work', 'We stayed 5 weeks!'): (1) $40 nightly - passes; no gateway (Kansas City 140 km), family has not stayed; (2) nightly rate on its own rates page and Firefly sells one night - passes; (3) no minimum, the engine sold a single night - passes; (4) a one-night search for Tue 2027-06-15 showed 6 of 17 sites open (2, 3, 7, 9, 11, 14) - passes; the 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-01 searches were stopped by a reCAPTCHA check, so winter occupancy is unread; (5) RV park, no homes - passes. I read it as a work-stay leaning transient park that sells nights, not long-stay in character.

Ratings: Google 4.7 / 15 (the park's own widget says 'Based on 15 reviews'); RV Life 5 stars from 6, $$ (avg_rate $36). Presence passes on the operator's site with phone plus a live booking page (Google is under 25 reviews).

Policies worth knowing: 'RVs ten (10) years and older are allowed at the discretion of the park owner' (EKKO 2023 passes until 2033); generators prohibited; no tents; heated water hose required in winter; 1 vehicle per site. Review: 'Make sure you pay close attention to the size of the site you choose because some are very small' (Cari Webb, Google, ~1 year ago) - the engine's smallest listed was 37 ft.
Website line: the stored first line https://www.lanternlightsrvpark.com/ works (serves the same site); the Firefly line is now booking.url.
